why: MAX_AGE_S (900 s) from the transmission's END: a transcript of one that ended 901 s ago raises nothing, 900 s ago still does; a re-text of the old one is gated the same way (its end, not the re-text's time). The airport watch's own gate is STALE_S (600 s) from the START.
